summary: Well-designed, preregistered paired confirmatory study comparing a deterministic validator against the same validator plus sandboxed emulation on synthetic LLM-generated NetOps tasks (Npairs=720). Results show a negligible aggregated detection gain (1/720); analysis, preregistration, and archival artifacts appear complete. The manuscript is scientifically sound but requires several manuscript-level corrections and clarifications before finalisation.
critical_issues: Citation and bibliography semantics: the manuscript must use and present a standard IEEE-numbered reference list that maps each in-text numeric citation to a verified bibliographic entry; currently the mapping between in-text markers (e.g. [1]–[5]) and the archived/verified records is unclear.

Disclosure Statement wording: condense to a concise statement that reports the mandatory items (models, orchestration framework, preregistration id+hash, human-autonomy boundary) and avoid reproducing run-level execution logs, per-file inventories, or non-required full artifact hashes in the paper body.

Power / inferential framing: the manuscript must explicitly state (in Methods and/or Results) that the preregistered minimum detectable effect (0.20) was the design target and that the observed marginal effect (≈0.0014) is far below that threshold; this limitation must be prominent and cannot be left implicit.

Citation support for claims: each literature-backed claim in Introduction/Related Work must be tied to a specific verified reference that actually supports that claim (do not rely on aggregated numeric ranges or unspecified 'survey' citations).
required_revisions: Replace any nonstandard or ambiguous citation tokens with IEEE-style numeric citations and include a bibliography with full IEEE-formatted entries that exactly match the verified referenced records; ensure every numbered citation in-text maps to an explicit bibliography entry and that each cited record supports the proximate claim.

Condense the Disclosure Statement within the five-page limit to only the mandatory elements (model identifiers, orchestration adapter family, preregistration id and SHA-256, short description of human role/autonomy boundary, and pointer to the archived execution manifest). Remove or relocate run-internal paths, per-file inventories, and nonrequired artifact hashes to the archival bundle (refer to the manifest) rather than the paper text.

Prominently report the preregistered minimum effect-of-interest (20 percentage points), the planned power assumptions, and explicitly state that the study was powered for that effect and therefore not sensitive to very small absolute differences; move this explanation into Methods (and summarize briefly in Results/Discussion).

In Methods, clarify sampling semantics exactly as recorded (temperature = null interpreted as unset; shared_initial_candidate semantics mean a single initial generation was used for both conditions). Keep this literal wording and avoid implying deterministic sampling when temperature is unset.

Ensure each claim that cites prior work names the specific reference(s) (by number) that substantiate it; if any cited verification record does not support the proximate claim, correct the claim or replace the citation with an appropriate supporting record from the archived verified bibliography.
optional_revisions: Include (as a short appendix paragraph or a compact figure/table) the representative paired case that produced the single guarded-only detection (n10), with a one-paragraph interpretation of why emulation detected it and the validator did not (artifact available in the archive).

Report a brief post-hoc descriptive summary (not as a new confirmatory test) of per-class and per-vendor detection counts from the archived artifacts to illustrate heterogeneity even if exploratory (artifacts appear to exist).

Add a one-sentence clarification of the exact McNemar/exact-test implementation and the paired-bootstrap CI procedure (bootstrap seed and resamples are archived; cite the analysis artifact file path in the manifest rather than pasting logs).
